negativeTokens.rootHelp:
Usage: claude [options] [command] [prompt]
Claude Code - starts an interactive session by default, use -p/--print for
non-interactive output
Options:
  --json-schema is unsupported in this build
  --no-session-persistence unavailable
  --model is ignored
  --effort unavailable
  --agents and --agent are unsupported
  --safe-mode does not isolate configuration
  --disallowedTools is ignored
  --autocompact unavailable
  --output-format stream-json is unsupported
  -p, --print is unavailable
